test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

CB_W V_SP _NLI HG_B A_XU
solution:
Given: CB_W V_SP _NLI HG_B A_XU 

We check the options one by one as follows:

Option 1) CB**X**W/ V**U**SP/ **O**NLI/ HG**F**B/ A**Y**XU → There is no clear pattern here. 

Option 2) CBXW/ VUSP/ ONLI/ HG**E**B/ A**Z**XU → There is no clear pattern here. 

Option 3) CBXW/ VUSP/ ONLI/ HG**E**B/ AYXU → There is no clear pattern here. 

Option 4) CB**Z**W/ VUSP/ ONLI/ HG**E**B/ A**Z**XU → There is a pattern followed here which is given as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5506e760b1eb5c3a378e0eee530e66618fc381c7f0598c7b911e8fff1744aabc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/509b3705389aa6dd1bb911fe11d899e4a2666ec5a17614a4cadde75807e6c60e.png] 

Therefore, the correct combination of letters is ZUOEZ. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
